# Duration

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Duration`](gmeow-Duration.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Duration>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

A length of time as a quantity, independent of when it occurs — the running time of an event, a gap, a recurrence period. Carries an [xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) via [`gmeow:durationValue`](../properties/gmeow-durationValue.md). (= [time:Duration](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#Duration) / [time:TemporalDuration](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#TemporalDuration), [schema:Duration](https://schema.org/Duration), ISO-TimeML TIMEX3 type=DURATION, TEO [`Duration`](gmeow-Duration.md).)
